scenario.name: Dropbox Inbox Watcher
scenario.description: Polls a Dropbox folder every 5 minutes for new file uploads and sends an email notification for each one. Requires one credential: dropbox_token.

agents.name: Watch Dropbox Inbox
agents.description: Polls /inbox every 5 minutes for new or modified files. Add your Dropbox access token as a credential named dropbox_token before enabling.

agents.name: Format File Notification
agents.description: Builds a subject line and plain-text body from the file metadata emitted by the read agent.

templates.subject: New file in Dropbox: {{ name }}

agents.name: Send Arrival Email
agents.description: Sends one email per new file. Change to_email to your address before enabling.
